# bintables/or

> || : short-circuit with a conditional jump; produces 0 or 1.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/or.pkg) · translates [std/or](../std/or.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
{left}
test rax, rax
jnz {L.true}
{right}
test rax, rax
jz {L.done}
{L.true}:
mov eax, 1
{L.done}:
```
